say:3:1422309001:1.text: Freda... I'm a terrible husband and father...
say:3:1422309001:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达……我不是一个称职的丈夫和父亲……

say:4:1422309002:1.text: But Freda didn't even blame you for anything.
say:4:1422309002:1.source_cn: 可是弗瑞达并没有埋怨你呀？

say:5:1422309003:1.text: I've only ever thought about my own goals and feelings! Even now, standing at the doorstep of my home, I can't let go of my pride and face them!
say:5:1422309003:1.source_cn: 一直以来我只考虑自己的抱负和心情，就像现在，哪怕在家门...

say:6:1422309004:1.text: I caused them so much needless worry. They never cared about wealth or fame—all they ever wanted was for me to be by their side...
say:6:1422309004:1.source_cn: 我让她们增加了那么多无谓的担心，却从没想过，她们需要的...

say:7:1422309005:1.source_cn: 我决定了，我要回家见她们！

say:8:1422309006:1.text: That's great that you've finally figured it out! They will be so happy to see you!
say:8:1422309006:1.source_cn: 你能想通真是太好啦！她们见到你一定会很高兴的。

say:9:1422309007:1.text: Freda invited us to dinner tonight and said she would prepare a hearty meal for everyone.
say:9:1422309007:1.source_cn: 刚好今天晚上弗瑞达邀请我们去吃晚饭，她说会准备一顿丰盛...

say:10:1422309008:1.text: If you show up at dinner, it'll be a wonderful surprise!
say:10:1422309008:1.source_cn: 如果在晚餐时分哈尔格突然出现，她们一定会很惊喜！

say:11:1422309009:0.text: Before I go, I need to prepare something. I actually got them a gift, a lute I made myself.
say:11:1422309009:0.source_cn: 在见她们之前，我还想准备一些东西……其实，我给弗瑞达和...

say:12:1422309010:1.text: But I didn't prepare any wrapping paper or anything...
say:12:1422309010:1.source_cn: 我想把礼物亲手交到她们手上，但我还没来得及准备包装……

say:13:1422309011:1.text: We can use flowers! The brighter, the better! Come on, let's go pick some and make your gift look amazing!
say:13:1422309011:1.source_cn: 最好的包装就是鲜艳的花朵，我们去采点花装饰一下礼物吧！...
